arxiv-2205-10645.title: The distance to the border of a random tree Thanks: Research of V. Maciá was partially funded by grant MTM2017-85934-C3-2-P2 of Ministerio de Economía y Competitividad of Spain and European Research Council Advanced Grant 834728
arxiv-2205-10645.creator: Víctor J. Maciá
arxiv-2205-10645.description: Abstract . We consider a Galton–Watson process conditioned to have total progeny equal to n n and investigate the asymptotic probability that the process exhibits a distance to the border (i.e., the minimal distance from the root to a leaf) of at least k k as n → ∞ n\to\infty .

arxiv-2301-12642.title: Exploring the Constructicon: Linguistic Analysis of a Computational CxG
arxiv-2301-12642.creator: Jonathan Dunn
arxiv-2301-12642.description: Abstract Recent work has formulated the task for computational construction grammar as producing a constructicon given a corpus of usage. Previous work has evaluated these unsupervised grammars using both internal metrics (for example, Minimum Description Length) and external metrics (for example, performance on a dialectology task).

B. Amôres, A. C. Krabbe, L. Binette, A. Feltre, T. Storchi-Bergmann. For the first time, the sulphur abundance relative to hydrogen (S/H) in the Narrow Line Regions of a sample of Seyfert 2 nuclei (Sy 2s) has been derived via direct estimation of the electron temperature.

arxiv-2312-09923.title: Reactive collisions between electrons and BeH + above dissociation threshold
arxiv-2312-09923.creator: E. Djuissi 1, J. Boffelli 1, R. Hassaine 1, N. Pop 2, V. Laporta 3, K. Chakrabarti 4, M. A. Ayouz 5, J. Zs Mezei 1,6, I. F. Schneider 1,7
arxiv-2312-09923.description: Abstract Our previous studies of dissociative recombination, and vibrational excitation/de-excitation of the BeH + ion, based on the multichannel quantum defect theory, are extended to collision energies above the dissociation threshold, taking into account the vibrational continua of the BeH + ion and, consequently, its dissociative excitation.

arxiv-2408-02436.creator: Kartik Panda, Daniel Potashnikov, Asaf Pesach, Maxime Barbier, Anna Eyal, Thierry Ouisse, Amit Keren, Nimrod Bachar

arxiv-2504-12780.title: Controlling the transverse multipole components in rf cavity modes using the azimuthal modulation method
arxiv-2504-12780.creator: L. M. Wroe, W. Wuensch, R. J. Apsimon
arxiv-2504-12780.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by L. M. Wroe, W. Wuensch, R. J. Apsimon. Recent work introduced a systematic method for designing so-called azimuthally modulated rf cavities that support transverse magnetic modes composed of user-desired multipoles, enabling precision control of the magnitude and orientation of multipolar components in rf cavity design. This paper extends this method to practical implementation by deriving the multipolar expansion of the longitudinal electric field in such rf cavities with beam pipes, as well as the momentum change of ultra-relativistic particles traversing these modes.

pmc-10708189.title: Tracking DNA-based antigen-specific T cell receptors during progression to type 1 diabetes
pmc-10708189.creator: Angela M. Mitchell, Erin E. Baschal, Kristen A. McDaniel, Theodore Fleury, Hyelin Choi, Laura Pyle, Liping Yu, Marian J. Rewers, Maki Nakayama, Aaron W. Michels
pmc-10708189.description: T cells targeting self-proteins are important mediators in autoimmune diseases. T cells express unique cell-surface receptors (TCRs) that recognize peptides presented by major histocompatibility molecules. TCRs have been identified from blood and pancreatic islets of individuals with type 1 diabetes (T1D).

pmc-11543046.title: Bioinformatics analysis reveals SOD1 is a prognostic factor in lung adenocarcinoma
pmc-11543046.creator: Ling Gao, Wei Wang, Haishan Ma, Minghui Yin, Xuejiao Yang, Ruihui Han, Shuta Ohara, Dohun Kim, Guangyan Wang
pmc-11543046.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundLung cancer is a major cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide. Unfortunately, non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) often lacks clear clinical symptoms and molecular markers for early diagnosis, which can hinder the initiation of timely treatments. In this study, we conducted an extensive bioinformatics analysis of copper-zinc superoxide dismutase (SOD1), a molecule linked to lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) to enhance early detection and treatment approaches for this condition.MethodsA bioinformatics analysis was conducted using a dataset from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) database.

pmc-12585955.title: Case Report: Extended survival in KRAS-G12V NSCLC with leptomeningeal metastasis through integrated intrathecal chemotherapy and systemic therapies
pmc-12585955.creator: Yun Chen, Zhiquan Qin, Luying Zhan, Xinchang Guo, Koji Fukuda, Qihao Zhou
pmc-12585955.description: Leptomeningeal metastasis (LM) is among the most severe complications in lung cancer patients, particularly for those without targetable gene mutations, who typically survive just 1–4 months. We present the case of a 68-year-old man with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and LM (pT1cN0M1b, stage IVB) whose primary lesion was early-stage with no other distant metastases.

pmc-13256692.title: Exploring Drivers of Children’s Food Choices: A Multi-Source Process Evaluation of a School-Based Nutrition Education Program
pmc-13256692.creator: Mariusz Jaworski
pmc-13256692.description: Children’s food choices are shaped early in life through cognitive, social, and environmental influences, yet relatively little is known about how school-based nutrition education supports these processes in routine settings. This study examined mechanisms potentially relevant to children’s food choices using a multi-source process evaluation of the municipal “I Know What I Eat” program implemented in Warsaw primary schools.

pmc-13372851.title: Epigenetic Control of Mammalian Cardiomyocyte Proliferation
pmc-13372851.creator: Francesca Butera, David A. Elliott, Enzo R. Porrello
pmc-13372851.description: Purpose of ReviewPostnatal shutdown of the mammalian cardiomyocyte cell cycle underpins limited regenerative capacity of the adult heart. An epigenetic programme regulates a switch at birth from a proliferative state to functional maturity. Identification of the molecular components regulating this switch has revealed therapeutic opportunities for heart regeneration that have started entering the clinic.

uslaw-usc-t11-s707.title: 11 U.S.C. § 707 — Dismissal of a case or conversion to a case under chapter 11 or 13
uslaw-usc-t11-s707.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t11-s707.description: United States Code, Title 11 (Bankruptcy); Chapter 7 (Liquidation); Subchapter I (Officers And Administration). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The court may dismiss a case under this chapter only after notice and a hearing and only for cause, including— (1) unreasonable delay by the debtor that is prejudicial to creditors; (2) nonpayment of any fees or charges required under chapter 123.

uslaw-usc-t42-s291l.title: 42 U.S.C. § 291l — Conference of State agencies
uslaw-usc-t42-s291l.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s291l.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 6A (Public Health Service); Subchapter IV (Construction And Modernization Of Hospitals And Other Medical Facilities); Part D (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whenever in his opinion the purposes of this subchapter would be promoted by a conference, the Surgeon General may invite representatives of as many State agencies, designated.
